"""RoboLab eai-standard/2.2 controller record for mustard_above_raisin."""
import sys, json, time, os
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT='/app/output'
CAM='egocentric_mirrored_camera'

def save_result(res, name):
    res.save(os.path.join(OUT, name))
    print(json.dumps({k:res.meta.get(k) for k in ('done','reason','plan','clipped','control_steps_chunk','executed_rows','stopped')}, default=str))
    if res.meta.get('done'):
        print('EPISODE DONE',res.meta.get('reason'))

def main():
    r=Robot()
    s=r.spec()
    print('STATUS',json.dumps(r.status()))
    o=r.get_obs(depth=True, video='none')
    p=np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'],dtype=float)
    q=p[:7]
    tcp=p[8:15]
    print('CURRENT_TCP',tcp.tolist(),'GRIPPER_OPENING',p[24])
    quat=tcp[3:7]
    hover=np.array([0.432,0.207,0.235,*quat,0.0])
    ik=r.ik({'tcp':hover[:7]},seed=q)
    print('IK_HOVER',json.dumps(ik))
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',hover.reshape(1,8),video='both',video_fps=5,depth='none',
                 note='Move above mustard bottle, gripper open')
    save_result(res,'01_hover')
    print('STATUS',json.dumps(r.status()))

if __name__=='__main__': main()
